_note: Hover help for File Manager's buttons, check boxes and tabs (project-owned). Key = the control's text, optionally preceded by where it is (tab / sub-tab / group box titles, or a dialog's title), joined with ' > '. The most specific match wins; '&', a trailing '...' and case are ignored.

ToolTips.Register drive: Add the connected drive picked on the left to the catalog (scanning a drive also registers it).
ToolTips.Set priority: Give the selected drive this priority. When two copies are otherwise equal, the copy on the drive with the lower number is kept.
ToolTips.Health check: Show what Windows knows about the health of each disk (Get-PhysicalDisk). Many USB enclosures hide the drive's own health data.
ToolTips.Open drive: Open the selected drive in Explorer.
ToolTips.Forget drive: Remove the selected drive and its files from the catalog. Nothing on the drive changes; scan it again to bring it back.
ToolTips.Batches: Every batch of moves and its steps.
ToolTips.Show commands: Show the PowerShell that was shown before the selected batch ran.
ToolTips.Export batch CSV: Save every step of the selected batch to a CSV file.
ToolTips.Export duplicates CSV: Save every duplicate group and copy to a CSV file.
ToolTips.Export HTML report: Save a report of drives, duplicate groups and batches as a web page.
ToolTips.Refresh drives: Read the list of connected drives again.
ToolTips.Copy with Robocopy: Copy the source drive's _Clean into the target in a Robocopy window. Files already in the target are never overwritten.
ToolTips.Verify copy: Read every file on both sides and compare them. The result is listed below; problems in the lower list.
ToolTips.Remove verified source files: Permanently delete only the source files the selected verify run found identical in the target.
ToolTips.Open batch: Open the selected batch: tick steps to move, undo, or delete (duplicates). Double-clicking a batch does the same.
ToolTips.Start fresh: Empty the catalog (drives, scans, hashes, duplicate groups) to begin again. Nothing on any drive changes. You choose whether to keep the batch history.
ToolTips.Not done yet: Tick only the steps shown that have not run yet (planned or failed).
ToolTips.Duplicates only: Tick only the duplicate folders shown (moves to _Duplicates).
ToolTips._Clean only: Tick only the folders and files shown that go to _Clean.
ToolTips.Tick highlighted: Tick the rows you highlighted (click, Shift+click, Ctrl+click).
ToolTips.Move selected: Move the ticked rows: Duplicate to _Duplicates, the rest to _Clean (an older copy swaps with the one in _Clean). You see the exact moves first.
ToolTips.Undo selected: Move the ticked steps that are done back to where they were.
ToolTips.Delete selected duplicates: Permanently delete the ticked duplicates from _Duplicates, after reading each one again and comparing it with its kept copy. Anything not identical is kept.
ToolTips.Folders: Each folder: already in the catalog, partly, or new - and where it already is.
ToolTips.Files not found: The files that are not in the catalog yet (or only matched by size).
ToolTips.Export CSV: Save the folders and the files not found to a CSV file.
ToolTips.File Manager: The one page: pick a drive, Scan, see what is duplicate, unique or partly, tick rows and move them.
ToolTips.Load drives: Read the list of connected drives again (plug drives in and out as you like).
ToolTips.Scan: Read every folder and file of the drive into the hash database (read only). Files already hashed and unchanged are not read again. Stop is safe.
ToolTips.Stop: Stop after the current file or step. Work done so far is kept.
ToolTips.More: Drives and priority, History (undo or delete only some moves), Check a folder, Consolidate.
ToolTips.Up one level: Go back to the folder above (after double-clicking into a folder).
ToolTips.Select all: Tick every row shown (rows marked 'Older copy found' are left out while the swap setting is Ask).
ToolTips.Open folder: Open the highlighted folder in Explorer.
ToolTips.Undo last: Move everything of the last move back to where it was. Older moves: More > History.
ToolTips.Delete duplicates: Permanently delete what is waiting in _Duplicates, after reading each folder again and comparing it with its kept copy. Anything not identical is kept.
ToolTips.Drives and priority: Every drive in the database: priority for keeping copies, health check, forget a drive, Start fresh.
ToolTips.History: Every move: undo or delete only the ones you tick, export, see the commands.
ToolTips.Check a folder: Is a folder (for example on a thumb drive) already in the database? Reads it and compares; nothing is added or moved.
ToolTips.Consolidate: Later: copy each drive's _Clean to one NTFS drive with Robocopy, verify every file, remove the verified source files.
ToolTips.Hash every file during a scan: On: every file is read once, so every match is confirmed. Off: only files that might be duplicates are read (faster).
ToolTips.Reset File Manager settings to defaults: Put the File Manager settings back to: Ask, 2 hours, hash every file, list every folder, ignore nothing (Save to keep it).
ToolTips.Refresh: Read the data again and redraw this list.
